headline: TECK AVOIDS HIGHLAND VALLEY STRIKE — New Deal Reached at Canada's Largest Open-Pit Copper Mine
snippet: Teck Resources and United Steelworkers Local 7619 reached a new collective agreement at Highland Valley Copper in British Columbia, averting a strike by more than 1,200 workers who had voted 100% in favour of action after the prior contract expired September 30. The mine produces approximately 300 million lbs of copper annually and is the largest open-pit copper operation in Canada.

headline: FED HOLD IS LOCKED — SILVER POSITIONING IS NOT: XAG Down 9.3% Since Oct 9 as Ratio Hits 73:1
snippet: GoldSilver.com's October 2026 silver outlook notes prediction markets now lean heavily toward a Fed hold at Wednesday's FOMC meeting, but warns the real unknown is silver positioning: the metal has fallen 9.3% since October 9 while gold dropped only 3.4%, pushing the gold-silver ratio from 69:1 to 73:1 and raising the question of whether silver's underperformance is a setup for a sharper recovery.

headline: GOLD AT $4,010 ENTERING FOMC WEEK — Bull Target $4,075, Bear Target $3,890 as Warsh Prepares Wednesday Statement
snippet: Technical analysis published Monday puts gold at $4,010 entering the critical FOMC week, with a bullish scenario targeting $4,075 if the Fed signals a December hold and a bearish scenario pointing to $3,890 if Warsh adopts a hawkish tone. September PCE data lands Thursday, giving markets a second macro data point the same week.

headline: HORMUZ DIPLOMACY COOLS OIL — Gold Reclaims $4,000 as Rate-Hike Inflation Premium Unwinds
snippet: Gold reclaimed $4,000 on October 26 after Strait of Hormuz diplomatic progress pushed crude oil lower, unwinding the inflation premium that had dragged the metal down to an intraday low of $3,977. Kitco's technical levels set immediate resistance at $4,032–$4,075 and support at $3,963, with the FOMC statement Wednesday the next decisive catalyst.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD HITS ITS FLOOR AT $4,092 FAIR VALUE — But Buyers Scoring at a Loss Until Fed Clears
snippet: GoldSeek analyst Mark Mead Baillie revises his gold fair value estimate upward to $4,092 and argues the metal has found its technical floor, with dip buyers stepping in but unable to recover the position at a profit until after the FOMC uncertainty clears this week. The piece closes with a note on tungsten as a rising monetary substitute drawing institutional interest.

headline: GOLDSEEK: HUI/GOLD RATIO HITS 200-DMA TARGET — Miner Margins Bleed as Gold Crashes vs Oil, Key Input Cost
snippet: Gary Tanashian's NFTRH commentary notes the HUI/Gold ratio has landed exactly on its original downside target at the 200-day moving average, with gold miners' product crashing relative to crude oil — their primary mining cost driver. Tanashian says he holds light positions in royalty companies like Royal Gold and Wheaton Precious Metals as a lower-cost-exposure hedge while avoiding direct producer leverage.

headline: FURY GOLD DRILLS 14.95 G/T AU OVER 4.25M AT EAU CLAIRE — Phase 2 at 21,857m Completed Across 26 Assayed Holes
snippet: Fury Gold Mines (TSX: FURY) released results from hole 26EC-131 at its Eau Claire project in northern Quebec, returning 14.95 g/t gold over 4.25 metres true width, among the highest-grade intercepts in the Phase 2 program to date. Phase 2 has now reached 21,857 metres with assays in hand for 26 holes, with the disclosed holes feeding into an upcoming resource update.

headline: LITHIUM NEEDS 134 NEW MINES AND $100B TO MEET 2050 DEMAND — Study Exposes Funding Gap as Spot Prices Stay Depressed
snippet: A new analysis quantifies the supply-side challenge in lithium: global demand is projected to more than triple by 2050, requiring the equivalent of 134 new mines and over $100 billion in investment. The report lands as spot lithium carbonate and spodumene prices sit near cycle lows, raising pointed questions about whether capital markets will fund the required build-out.

headline: AXEL REE PRODUCES 54.4% TREO RARE EARTH CARBONATE — No Costly Impurity-Removal Step Required at Woolrich
snippet: Axel REE (ASX: AXL) has produced a 54.4% total rare earth oxide mixed rare earth carbonate product from its Woolrich project without the costly impurity-removal processing stage typically required in rare earth flowsheets. The result confirms a simpler, lower-cost path to a saleable product and could meaningfully reduce the capital intensity of any development scenario.

headline: AURA ENERGY COMPLETES TIRIS URANIUM FLOWSHEET — Pilot Plant Commissioning October-November, FID December 2026
snippet: Aura Energy (ASX/AIM: AEE) has completed the final flowsheet for its 91-million-pound Tiris uranium project in Mauritania, with pilot plant commissioning targeted this month and a Final Investment Decision by year-end 2026. Financing discussions with the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation for approximately $150–170 million of senior debt are ongoing ahead of what would be Mauritania's first uranium mine.
